benchmark: AED vs conventional Crystal — small-model comprehension
hypothesis: AED-style Crystal ('reads like statements', per the premium template's aed-conventions skill) lets smaller models reason about and understand code intent better than conventional compressed style.

probe_descriptions.intent: Explain what the code does and why (business intent, not line-by-line).
probe_descriptions.modification: Describe how to make a specified behavior change correctly.
probe_descriptions.defect: A subtle behavioral question / planted-defect-style probe about an edge case.

method.answering_model: Claude Haiku (answered blind: never told which style variant it was reading)
method.grading: Graded blind by a model grader that never saw which style produced the answer. 0 = wrong/missed, 1 = partially correct, 2 = fully correct. Max 6 per variant per pair.
method.semantic_equivalence: Each pair's two variants were verified behaviorally identical by a Crystal differential-test harness (scratchpad aed_bench/build_harness.py + tests.cr) that runs both variants against shared checks and diffs outputs.
method.note: Haiku's raw answer transcripts and the grader's rationales were not persisted; this file carries the full source of both variants per pair plus the graded scores, which is sufficient to re-run the probes.

pairs.topic: auth/session logic — post-password MFA routing and pending-challenge TTL
pairs.aed_source:
module Auth
  # Routes a user who has just passed the password check. The password is only
  # the FIRST factor: an MFA-enrolled regular user must verify a second factor
  # before a session is established. Admin accounts have no MFA flag here.
  module PostPasswordRouter
    MFA_PENDING_TTL_SECONDS = 300

    def self.next_step(user : Users::Regular | Users::Admin | Nil) : Symbol
      return :reject_login if user.nil?
      return :begin_mfa_challenge if second_factor_required?(user)

      :complete_login
    end

    # Only regular users can enroll in MFA in this template.
    def self.second_factor_required?(user : Users::Regular | Users::Admin) : Bool
      if user.is_a?(Users::Regular)
        user.mfa_enabled
      else
        false
      end
    end

    # A pending second factor is honored only inside the TTL window; a stale
    # challenge sends the user back to the password step. This bounds the
    # window an attacker has to guess codes.
    def self.mfa_challenge_still_valid?(pending_started_at : Int64?, now : Int64) : Bool
      return false if pending_started_at.nil?

      seconds_pending = now - pending_started_at
      seconds_pending <= MFA_PENDING_TTL_SECONDS
    end
  end
end
pairs.conventional_source:
module Auth
  module PostPasswordRouter
    MFA_PENDING_TTL_SECONDS = 300

    def self.next_step(user : Users::Regular | Users::Admin | Nil) : Symbol
      return :reject_login unless user
      user.is_a?(Users::Regular) && user.mfa_enabled ? :begin_mfa_challenge : :complete_login
    end

    def self.second_factor_required?(user : Users::Regular | Users::Admin) : Bool
      user.is_a?(Users::Regular) ? user.mfa_enabled : false
    end

    def self.mfa_challenge_still_valid?(pending_started_at : Int64?, now : Int64) : Bool
      pending_started_at ? (now - pending_started_at) <= MFA_PENDING_TTL_SECONDS : false
    end
  end
end

pairs.topic: lead scoring — email-domain classification plus message-effort bonus
pairs.aed_source:
class LeadScorer
  BUSINESS_DOMAIN_BONUS     =  25
  SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_LEN   = 120
  SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_BONUS =  10

  FREE_PROVIDER_DOMAINS = %w[gmail.com yahoo.com outlook.com hotmail.com icloud.com proton.me]
  DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS    = %w[mailinator.com guerrillamail.com yopmail.com temp-mail.org]

  # Triage score: business senders who write substantively float to the top.
  def self.score(email : String, message : String) : Int32
    domain_class = classify_domain(extract_domain(email))

    score = 0
    score += BUSINESS_DOMAIN_BONUS if domain_class == "business"
    score -= BUSINESS_DOMAIN_BONUS if domain_class == "suspicious"
    score += SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_BONUS if substantial_message?(message)
    score
  end

  def self.classify_domain(domain : String) : String
    return "unknown" if domain.empty?
    return "suspicious" if DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS.includes?(domain)
    return "free_provider" if FREE_PROVIDER_DOMAINS.includes?(domain)
    return "business" if plausible_custom_domain?(domain)
    "unknown"
  end

  # A custom domain must contain a dot that is not at either end.
  def self.plausible_custom_domain?(domain : String) : Bool
    domain.includes?('.') && !domain.starts_with?('.') && !domain.ends_with?('.')
  end

  # A few sentences of detail is a real effort signal vs. a one-liner.
  def self.substantial_message?(message : String) : Bool
    message.strip.size >= SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_LEN
  end

  def self.extract_domain(address : String) : String
    normalized = address.strip.downcase
    at_index = normalized.rindex('@')
    return "" unless at_index
    normalized[(at_index + 1)..].strip
  end
end
pairs.conventional_source:
class LeadScorer
  BUSINESS_DOMAIN_BONUS     =  25
  SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_LEN   = 120
  SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_BONUS =  10

  FREE_PROVIDER_DOMAINS = %w[gmail.com yahoo.com outlook.com hotmail.com icloud.com proton.me]
  DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS    = %w[mailinator.com guerrillamail.com yopmail.com temp-mail.org]

  def self.score(email : String, message : String) : Int32
    dc = classify_domain(extract_domain(email))
    base = dc == "business" ? BUSINESS_DOMAIN_BONUS : dc == "suspicious" ? -BUSINESS_DOMAIN_BONUS : 0
    base + (message.strip.size >= SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_LEN ? SUBSTANTIAL_MESSAGE_BONUS : 0)
  end

  def self.classify_domain(domain : String) : String
    case
    when domain.empty?                                                                 then "unknown"
    when DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS.includes?(domain)                                          then "suspicious"
    when FREE_PROVIDER_DOMAINS.includes?(domain)                                       then "free_provider"
    when domain.includes?('.') && !domain.starts_with?('.') && !domain.ends_with?('.') then "business"
    else                                                                                    "unknown"
    end
  end

  def self.extract_domain(address : String) : String
    a = address.strip.downcase
    (i = a.rindex('@')) ? a[(i + 1)..].strip : ""
  end
end

pairs.topic: state transitions — document review workflow state machine
pairs.aed_source:
module Documents
  enum Status
    Draft
    InReview
    Approved
    Rejected
    Archived
  end

  # Review flow for client documents: a document moves strictly
  # draft -> in_review -> (approved | rejected). A rejected document returns
  # to draft for revision, only an approved document can be archived, and
  # archived is terminal, immutable history.
  module Workflow
    def self.transition_allowed?(from : Status, to : Status) : Bool
      allowed_destinations(from).includes?(to)
    end

    def self.allowed_destinations(from : Status) : Array(Status)
      if from.draft?
        [Status::InReview]
      elsif from.in_review?
        [Status::Approved, Status::Rejected]
      elsif from.rejected?
        [Status::Draft]
      elsif from.approved?
        [Status::Archived]
      else
        [] of Status
      end
    end

    def self.terminal?(status : Status) : Bool
      allowed_destinations(status).empty?
    end
  end
end
pairs.conventional_source:

      in .archived?  then [] of Status
      end
    end

      allowed_destinations(status).empty?
    end
  end
end

pairs.topic: file/storage handling — path-safe delete with metadata sidecar
pairs.aed_source:
module Storage
  # Deletes an object and its metadata sidecar from the local disk store.
  # Refuses any key that could reach outside the storage root.
  class LocalObjectRemover
    getter root : String

    def initialize(@root : String)
    end

    def delete(key : String) : Bool
      return false unless safe_key?(key)

      path = File.join(root, key)
      return false unless File.exists?(path)

      File.delete(path)
      remove_metadata_sidecar(path)
      true
    rescue error
      Log.error { "LocalObjectRemover.delete error: #{error.message}" }
      false
    end

    # A key may not be empty, may not be absolute, and may not contain a
    # ".." segment — any of those could escape the storage root.
    def safe_key?(key : String) : Bool
      return false if key.empty?
      return false if key.starts_with?('/')
      return false if key.split('/').includes?("..")
      true
    end

    # Content-type metadata lives in a "<path>.meta" sidecar written by put.
    private def remove_metadata_sidecar(path : String)
      meta_path = "#{path}.meta"
      File.delete(meta_path) if File.exists?(meta_path)
    end
  end
end

      !key.empty? && !key.starts_with?('/') && !key.split('/').includes?("..")
    end
  end
end

pairs.topic: rate limiting — sliding-window per-IP submission ceiling
pairs.aed_source:
# Sliding-window, in-memory rate limit for the contact form: an IP may
# submit at most MAX_SUBMISSIONS_PER_WINDOW times per rolling hour.
# Requests without a usable IP are never limited — we fail open on purpose.
class SubmissionRateLimiter
  MAX_SUBMISSIONS_PER_WINDOW = 3
  WINDOW_SECONDS             = 60 * 60

  def initialize
    @submission_times_by_ip = Hash(String, Array(Int64)).new
    @lock = Mutex.new
  end

  # Records this attempt, then reports whether the IP has now gone over the
  # ceiling. Every attempt is recorded, even ones that end up limited.
  def over_limit?(ip : String?, now : Int64) : Bool
    return false if ip.nil? || ip.empty?

    attempts_in_window = record_and_count(ip, now)
    attempts_in_window > MAX_SUBMISSIONS_PER_WINDOW
  end

  private def record_and_count(ip : String, now : Int64) : Int32
    window_start = now - WINDOW_SECONDS

    @lock.synchronize do
      recent_times = @submission_times_by_ip[ip]? || Array(Int64).new
      recent_times.reject! { |time| time < window_start }
      recent_times << now
      @submission_times_by_ip[ip] = recent_times
      recent_times.size
    end
  end
end
pairs.conventional_source:
class SubmissionRateLimiter
  MAX_SUBMISSIONS_PER_WINDOW = 3
  WINDOW_SECONDS             = 60 * 60

  def initialize
    @submission_times_by_ip = Hash(String, Array(Int64)).new
    @lock = Mutex.new
  end

  def over_limit?(ip : String?, now : Int64) : Bool
    return false unless ip && !ip.empty?
    window_start = now - WINDOW_SECONDS
    @lock.synchronize do
      times = (@submission_times_by_ip[ip] ||= [] of Int64)
      times.reject! { |t| t < window_start }
      times << now
      times.size > MAX_SUBMISSIONS_PER_WINDOW
    end
  end
end

pairs.topic: background scheduling — exponential retry backoff with dead-letter cutoff
pairs.aed_source:
module Jobs
  # Retry policy for failed background jobs: exponential backoff with a cap,
  # then dead-letter after the final attempt so a poison job cannot retry forever.
  module RetryPolicy
    MAX_ATTEMPTS       =   8
    BASE_DELAY_SECONDS =  30
    MAX_DELAY_SECONDS  = 600

    # attempts_made counts failures so far, including the one that just happened.
    def self.next_step(attempts_made : Int32) : {Symbol, Int32}
      return {:dead_letter, 0} if retries_exhausted?(attempts_made)

      {:retry, delay_before_next_attempt(attempts_made)}
    end

    def self.retries_exhausted?(attempts_made : Int32) : Bool
      attempts_made >= MAX_ATTEMPTS
    end

    # 30s, 60s, 120s ... doubling per failure, never above the ten-minute cap.
    def self.delay_before_next_attempt(attempts_made : Int32) : Int32
      uncapped_delay = BASE_DELAY_SECONDS * (2 ** (attempts_made - 1))
      if uncapped_delay > MAX_DELAY_SECONDS
        MAX_DELAY_SECONDS
      else
        uncapped_delay
      end
    end
  end
end
pairs.conventional_source:
module Jobs
  module RetryPolicy
    MAX_ATTEMPTS       =   8
    BASE_DELAY_SECONDS =  30
    MAX_DELAY_SECONDS  = 600

    def self.next_step(attempts_made : Int32) : {Symbol, Int32}
      attempts_made >= MAX_ATTEMPTS ? {:dead_letter, 0} : {:retry, delay_before_next_attempt(attempts_made)}
    end

    def self.retries_exhausted?(attempts_made : Int32) : Bool
      attempts_made >= MAX_ATTEMPTS
    end

    def self.delay_before_next_attempt(attempts_made : Int32) : Int32
      Math.min(BASE_DELAY_SECONDS * (2 ** (attempts_made - 1)), MAX_DELAY_SECONDS)
    end
  end
end

pairs.topic: validation — collect-all-errors form validation for inquiry submissions
pairs.aed_source:
# Field-level validation for the /stroll inquiry form. Returns every error
# at once so the visitor can fix the whole form in one pass.
class InquiryValidator
  MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH =   20
  MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 5000

  getter name : String
  getter email : String
  getter message : String

  def initialize(@name : String, @email : String, @message : String)
  end

  def errors : Array(String)
    found = [] of String
    found << "Name is required" if name_is_blank?
    found << "Email address does not look valid" unless email_looks_deliverable?
    found << "Message must be at least #{MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters" if message_too_short?
    found << "Message must be under #{MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters" if message_too_long?
    found
  end

  def valid? : Bool
    errors.empty?
  end

  private def name_is_blank? : Bool
    name.strip.empty?
  end

  # Deliberately loose: just a "local@domain.tld" shape. Real deliverability
  # is judged later by the MX lookup in lead scoring.
  private def email_looks_deliverable? : Bool
    email.matches?(/\A[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+\z/)
  end

  private def message_too_short? : Bool
    message.strip.size < MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH
  end

  private def message_too_long? : Bool
    message.strip.size > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH
  end
end

class InquiryValidator
  MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH =   20
  MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 5000
  EMAIL_FORMAT       = /\A[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+\z/

  getter name : String
  getter email : String
  getter message : String

  def initialize(@name : String, @email : String, @message : String)
  end

    e = [] of String
    e << "Name is required" if name.strip.empty?
    e << "Email address does not look valid" unless email.matches?(EMAIL_FORMAT)
    m = message.strip.size
    e << "Message must be at least #{MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters" if m < MIN_MESSAGE_LENGTH
    e << "Message must be under #{MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters" if m > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH
    e
  end

  def valid? : Bool
    errors.empty?
  end
end

pairs.topic: RBAC checks — admin/owner bypass plus org-role gated document actions
pairs.aed_source:
module Authorization
  # Access rules for client documents. Admins bypass all checks; a document's
  # owner has full control; organization members act by role — editors may
  # read and update, viewers may only read. Everyone else is denied.
  class DocumentPolicy
    getter user_id : Int64
    getter user_is_admin : Bool
    getter org_role : String?

    def initialize(@user_id : Int64, @user_is_admin : Bool, @org_role : String?)
    end

    def can?(action : Symbol, owner_id : Int64) : Bool
      return true if user_is_admin
      return true if owns_document?(owner_id)
      return can_act_as_editor?(action) if org_role == "editor"
      return action == :read if org_role == "viewer"

      false
    end

    private def owns_document?(owner_id : Int64) : Bool
      user_id == owner_id
    end

    # Editors may change content but never destroy it.
    private def can_act_as_editor?(action : Symbol) : Bool
      action == :read || action == :update
    end
  end
end
pairs.conventional_source:
module Authorization
  class DocumentPolicy
    getter user_id : Int64
    getter user_is_admin : Bool
    getter org_role : String?

    def initialize(@user_id : Int64, @user_is_admin : Bool, @org_role : String?)
    end

    def can?(action : Symbol, owner_id : Int64) : Bool
      return true if user_is_admin || user_id == owner_id
      case org_role
      when "editor" then action == :read || action == :update
      when "viewer" then action == :read
      else               false
      end
    end
  end
end

pairs.topic: queue/status flow — outbound-mail worker triage with stale-lock reclaim
pairs.aed_source:
module Mailer
  # Decides what the queue worker should do with one outbound email row.
  # Pending mail goes out once its scheduled time arrives. A "processing" row
  # whose lock is older than the stale threshold belonged to a crashed worker
  # and is reclaimed; anything already sent or failed is left alone.
  module QueueTriage
    STALE_LOCK_SECONDS = 15 * 60

    def self.decision(status : String, scheduled_at : Int64, locked_at : Int64?, now : Int64) : Symbol
      if status == "pending"
        if due_for_delivery?(scheduled_at, now)
          return :deliver
        else
          return :not_due_yet
        end
      end

      if status == "processing"
        return :reclaim if lock_gone_stale?(locked_at, now)
        return :leave_alone
      end

      :leave_alone
    end

    def self.due_for_delivery?(scheduled_at : Int64, now : Int64) : Bool
      scheduled_at <= now
    end

    # A worker that dies mid-send leaves the row locked; after 15 minutes we
    # assume the worker is gone and give the row back to the queue.
    def self.lock_gone_stale?(locked_at : Int64?, now : Int64) : Bool
      return false if locked_at.nil?

      (now - locked_at) > STALE_LOCK_SECONDS
    end
  end
end
pairs.conventional_source:
module Mailer
  module QueueTriage
    STALE_LOCK_SECONDS = 15 * 60

    def self.decision(status : String, scheduled_at : Int64, locked_at : Int64?, now : Int64) : Symbol
      case status
      when "pending"    then scheduled_at <= now ? :deliver : :not_due_yet
      when "processing" then locked_at && (now - locked_at) > STALE_LOCK_SECONDS ? :reclaim : :leave_alone
      else                   :leave_alone
      end
    end

    def self.due_for_delivery?(scheduled_at : Int64, now : Int64) : Bool
      scheduled_at <= now
    end

    def self.lock_gone_stale?(locked_at : Int64?, now : Int64) : Bool
      locked_at ? (now - locked_at) > STALE_LOCK_SECONDS : false
    end
  end
end
